actions.newValue: In Transit (Circle in the Square, opened 2016-12-11, closed 2017-04-16). No readable source reports it recouping before closing; this designation rests on that silence and on its closing coverage. No readable source states a capitalization, so none is shown. Per a budget filed with the NY AG in summer 2016 (Broadway Journal, Feb 2 2017, https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/economical-in-transit-seeks-boost-from-clinton-endorsement): the production needed minimum weekly sales of $439,000 to pay expenses (including credit card commissions and other extras that count toward League grosses); lead producer Janet Rosen said actual breakeven was below $400,000 because of conservative budgeting. Sales the week before were $338,000. The post describes the show as capitalized at just under $7M (not attributed to the filing, so capitalization is left unset).
